# Issue Creation Guidelines

When creating GitHub issues:

1. Always use one of:
   - Bug
   - Feature
   - Housekeeping

2. Use the templates in:
   .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/

3. Issues must include a "label" of one of:
   [Bug]
   [Feature]
   [Housekeeping]

4. New issues get a "triage" "label" as well. See @docs/agents/triage-labels.md

5. Always include:
   - Context
   - Acceptance criteria
   - Technical considerations

6. Prefer actionable issues over vague descriptions. Spec documents are the source of truth for features. Refer to them.
